name: windows-terminal

storage.rationale: Windows Terminal panes are host-session state; Vrooli does not persist terminal sessions.

description: Windows Terminal pane host for detachable operator workflows
installHint: Install Windows Terminal from the Microsoft.WindowsTerminal winget package.

linux.evidence: Windows Terminal panes are not a Linux terminal multiplexer.

macos.evidence: Windows Terminal panes are not a macOS terminal multiplexer.
